title: The Fiery Furnace
summary: God is able to rescue, and His people can stay faithful even before they know the outcome. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Daniel 3:13-30 and look for how this passage teaches: God is able to rescue, and His people can stay faithful even before they know the outcome.

tell_it: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego refused to worship the statue. God was with them in the fire.
understand_it: God is able to rescue, and His people can stay faithful even before they know the outcome. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: The Fiery Furnace reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Faith matters.
age_8_11_explanation: The Fiery Furnace shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: God is able to rescue, and His people can stay faithful even before they know the outcome.
teen_explanation: The Fiery Furnace gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that god is able to rescue, and His people can stay faithful even before they know the outcome. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: God is able to rescue, and His people can stay faithful even before they know the outcome.
Faith means trusting God enough to respond.
Courage grows when we remember God is with His people.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when faith is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: Who was with the men in the fire?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: God was with them. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that god is able to rescue, and His people can stay faithful even before they know the outcome.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Daniel 3:17 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in The Fiery Furnace?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Stand Tall
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: God is able to rescue, and His people can stay faithful even before they know the outcome.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from The Fiery Furnace. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
